zip_caveats: 90503, 90504 and 90505 are all Torrance. 90501 is about 70% Torrance and 30% Harbor Gateway, a part of the City of Los Angeles, by land; Harbor Gateway voters get Los Angeles city races and LAUSD's Charter Amendment SC, not Torrance's school and college races, so the guide asks which city you live in. 90277 is mostly Redondo Beach (about a quarter of its land is in Torrance); Redondo Beach voters have their own city measure and races that this ballot doesn't show. A few Torrance blocks use 90278 (mostly Redondo Beach), 90717 (mostly Lomita) or 90248 (mostly Gardena, Carson and Los Angeles); those ZIPs aren't listed here, so use your address. Torrance is split between two U.S. House districts on the new map: by the state Senate's ZIP directory, 90504 (north Torrance) is almost all the 43rd, 90505 (south Torrance) is almost all the 36th, and 90501 and 90503 are split. All of Torrance is in the 24th State Senate District and the 66th Assembly District. Two local races reach only part of the city: the Torrance Unified school board race for Trustee Area D (south Torrance) and the El Camino College race for Trustee Area 5. Torrance's Water Replenishment District division (Division 2) has no race this year, and Torrance isn't in the West Basin water district. Your official sample ballot at isb.lavote.gov shows exactly what's on yours.
notes: Torrance has no city races or city measures on this ballot. The mayor, three council seats, the city clerk and the city treasurer were elected on June 2, and the next city election is in March 2028. All of Torrance votes in the 24th State Senate District and the 66th Assembly District. Torrance is split between two U.S. House districts: most of north Torrance is in the 43rd, most of south Torrance is in the 36th, and the middle of the city is split between them. Two local races reach only part of Torrance: the school board race for Trustee Area D, in south Torrance, and the El Camino College race for Trustee Area 5. Your sample ballot shows which House district is yours and whether you have the two local races.
